mission.t: The Allegheny East Conference of Seventh-day Adventists exists to promote the sharing of the everlasting gospel of Jesus Christ ethnically [TA ETHNAE - "to all people groups"] within its assigned territory through Christ-centered leadership and responsible resource management

a.w: promote the sharing of the everlasting gospel

mission.t: Empowered by faith, united in purpose, we move communities forward across the eastern region. Through service, education, and fellowship, we build vibrant spaces where hope flourishes and lives are transformed. We embrace diversity, nurture spiritual growth, and champion compassion, extending a hand of love and support to all in need. Driven by the Seventh-day Adventist message, we strive to create a brighter future, one act of kindness and one life touched at a time.

a.w: extending a hand of love and support to all in need

mission.t: Believing in the imminent return of Christ, our mission in Central States Conference is to proclaim the everlasting Gospel* of Jesus Christ to every person in our nine state region inviting them to become fully devoted disciples of Jesus.
To reach the people of the Chesapeake region with the Christ-centered message of the Seventh-day Adventist Church.

mission.t: To share the hope of a soon returning Savior, involve the youth of the Conference in mission, and continue a strong camp and educational system for the strengthening of the local, national, and international Adventist movement.

mission.t: Walking Together in Faith, Hope, and Love.

(1) Kingdom Growth — Evangelism, Publishing, Religious Liberty
Share the everlasting gospel through personal and public evangelism, church planting, small group fellowship, community involvement, and healing the broken by applying media, technology, and talent to reach all in our territory.
(2) Discipling Youth — Children's/Junior Youth Ministries, Youth Ministries
Every family, church and school is committed to connecting our children and youth to Jesus for service and mission.
(3) Christian Education — Camp Meetings, Academy/Elementary Schools
Seek to make quality Christian education available and affordable to all children and youth entrusted to our conference family.
(4) Spiritual Life — Women's Ministries, Family Ministries, Prayer Ministries, Disability Ministries
Intimacy with God is nourished by prayer, study and application of the Word, public and private worship, and faithful stewardship that strengthen a personal commitment to serving Jesus as Savior and Lord.
(5) Shared Leadership — Young Adult Ministries, Men’s Ministries
Following the apostolic model, pastors and teachers partner with each member, resourcing and developing spiritual leaders for effective ministry.
(6) Serving Others — Adventist Community Services, Personal Ministries, Health Ministries, Prison Ministries
Serve others and build relationships through involvement in a wide variety of community activities and agencies.

a.w: developing spiritual leaders for effective ministry
prayer, study and application of the Word
